items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Fletcher Henderson arrangements, like . . . Edgar Sampson tunes, “Stomping at the Savoy”? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, yeah, yeah.

ctx.x: I remember loving the vocal, singing way above the band. And then “Blue Goose” and . . . Those are two that stick in my mind. Then all the Benny Goodman things, like “Air Mail Special” and all the things that I got to play with the band later.
Fletcher Henderson arrangements, like . . . Edgar Sampson tunes, “Stomping at the Savoy”?
